title: Near each point, a flat C¹ hypercone of A₀ coincides with an m-dimensional subspace of A₀ (parent steps 1, 3, 4)
statement: Local flatness. Data: P, m ∈ ℕ; a linear subspace A₀ ⊆ ℝ^P; M ⊆ ℝ^P; ν : ℝ^P → ℝ^P. Hypotheses: dim A₀ = m + 1; M ⊆ A₀; M is an embedded C¹ m-dimensional submanifold of ℝ^P (IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m M); tx ∈ M for every x ∈ M and t > 0; ν is differentiable at every x ∈ M; for every x ∈ M, ν(x) ∈ A₀, |ν(x)| = 1 and ν(x)·v = 0 for every v ∈ tangentSpace M x; and Dν(x)v = 0 (fderiv ℝ ν x v = 0) for every x ∈ M and v ∈ tangentSpace M x. Conclusion: for every x ∈ M there are a linear subspace H ⊆ A₀ with dim H = m and an open set O ⊆ ℝ^P with x ∈ O and O ∩ M = O ∩ H.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (A₀ : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (ν : Euclid P → Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ A₀ = m + 1 → M ⊆ (A₀ : Set (Euclid P)) → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m M → (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → ∀ x ∈ M, t • x ∈ M) → (∀ x ∈ M, DifferentiableAt ℝ ν x) → (∀ x ∈ M, ν x ∈ A₀ ∧ ‖ν x‖ = 1 ∧ ∀ v ∈ tangentSpace M x, inner ℝ (ν x) v = 0) → (∀ x ∈ M, ∀ v ∈ tangentSpace M x, fderiv ℝ ν x v = 0) → ∀ x ∈ M, ∃ H : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ H = m ∧ H ≤ A₀ ∧ ∃ O : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen O ∧ x ∈ O ∧ O ∩ M = O ∩ (H : Set (Euclid P))
